name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Banana Deep
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. From Banana OG x Deep Kush, Banana Deep is heavy-hitting with a deeply relaxing body high and calming euphoria. Its creamy banana aroma pairs with earthy sweetness from terpenes like Myrcene, Limonene, and Bisabolol. A powerhouse for evening relaxation.
